topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't rightly say I was surprised, no. Every so often, someone from our little patch leaves for the promise of greener fields, or in this case, the bustling noise of a distant town. But him? My closest pair of hands, the one who stood by me when the blight took half our crops, the one who shared bread through the leanest of winters. He’s gone and sold his family's land, packed his few belongings, and now he speaks of crossing half the kingdom like it's just a day's journey to the next village. He's turning his back on everything we've known, everything we’ve built. Can’t say I've the words to send him off, not when our work here is far from done. The earth needs tending, and it feels like a betrayal to let it go half-seen to the next sowing.
